test_TaskKey_serialization: test that TaskKey serialization roundtrip preserves CLASSIFICATION and MULTI_LABEL_CLASSIFICATION task keys
create_TaskKey_classification: create a TaskKey with name, TaskKind.CLASSIFICATION, and ClassificationMetadata specifying num_classes
create_TaskKey_multi_label: create a TaskKey with name, TaskKind.MULTI_LABEL_CLASSIFICATION, and MultiLabelClassificationMetadata specifying num_classes
run_TaskKey_to_dict: run TaskKey.to_dict to serialize a TaskKey instance into a dictionary representation
run_TaskKey_from_dict: run TaskKey.from_dict to restore a TaskKey instance from its serialized dictionary
